slides.title: Why did Sudan take Ethiopia to the UN?
What Sudan says
slides.body: Its foreign ministry says RSF used Ethiopian territory to launch drones at power stations.

slides.title: Ethiopia's position
slides.body: No immediate response, per Anadolu. Ethiopia has denied backing RSF before.

slides.title: Not verified
slides.body: Claims come from Sudan's side only. No independent confirmation yet.
